verdict.rationale: Square's own developer docs include an 'Offline Payments' page for the Android Mobile Payments SDK, which indicates a first-party offline card-acceptance capability. The evidence is only a page title, though, with no detail on how it works, and it is developer-facing rather than a feature of the merchant-ops app. Missing for 10: details on storing and forwarding transactions when connectivity returns, offline limits and risk terms, evidence of offline mode in the Square POS app or iOS and hardware, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
